LanguageData.RP_FuneralText: {0} lies in the morgue. A quiet burial is today's way and costs nothing. A funeral is held {1}, at the next free-time or work hour (never at night, never in a lockdown, a riot or a raid - it waits up to a day and then lapses to a quiet burial). It takes out of the regime for the hour the chaplain, if there is one, the friends and the gang mates of {0}, with the guards who escort them (busy for the hour), and their family comes as visitors if they are in touch and the visitation room can bring them.\n\nIt is a good day for the wing and for the friends, and a gang's members together at a grave are a show of strength.{2} An unanswered letter is a quiet burial.
LanguageData.RP_FuneralRivalNote: {0} was killed by a rival gang that is on the same wing, so one of them may turn up ({1} of the time) and a fight may come of it.
LanguageData.RP_FuneralTextStaff: {0}, of the prison's staff, lies in the morgue. A quiet burial is today's way and costs nothing. A funeral is held {1}, at the next free-time or work hour (never at night, never in a lockdown, a riot or a raid - it waits up to a day and then lapses to a quiet burial). The colleagues on duty and not needed elsewhere attend, the chaplain leads it if there is one and the warden speaks.\n\nThe staff take a funeral well. An unanswered letter is a quiet burial.
LanguageData.RP_FuneralStale: Already decided, or the time to decide has passed
LanguageData.RP_FuneralNoPlace: No chapel, no shuttle pad and no burial plot to hold it in
LanguageData.RP_FuneralPlace_Grave: at the grave in the burial plot
LanguageData.RP_FuneralLapsed: The funeral for {0} will not be held, {1} - a quiet burial.
LanguageData.RP_FuneralBroken: The funeral for {0} was broken off, {1}.
LanguageData.RP_FuneralWhy_NoHour: the regime has no free-time or work hour in the day
LanguageData.RP_FuneralWhy_Late: a lockdown, a riot, a raid, no guard to spare or nobody to send kept it for a day
LanguageData.RP_FuneralWhy_Rot: the body could not be kept any longer
LanguageData.RP_FuneralWhy_Trouble: a lockdown or a riot began
LanguageData.RP_Chr_FuneralLapsed: The funeral for {0} was not held, {1} - the burial was a quiet one.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_FuneralBroken: The funeral for {0} was broken off, {1}.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_FuneralScuffle: {0} of the {1} came to the funeral for {2}, and a fight broke out at the back.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_FuneralScuffleNone: {0} of the {1} stood at the back of the funeral for {2}, and nothing came of it.
